job.title: Consultant PIM/DAM (m/w/d)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your Consultant PIM role needs someone who makes product data flow cleanly into every channel – exactly what I delivered with PIM data pipelines at Rockwell Automation. What I bring in concrete terms:

– PIM pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub
– Product data modeling and ERP / MDM integration
– Requirements, functional specs and UAT with clients

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Consultant PIM | Product Data Pipelines, Data Modeling & E-Commerce Integration
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional PIM consultant with 5+ years in product information management for global e-commerce channels at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-commerce data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, modelled product, catalog and pricing data and resolved SAP ERP / MDM integration bottlenecks. Analyses client requirements, writes user stories and functional specifications, maps processes and supports UAT. Works hands-on in agile, international teams and uses AI tools in analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Laudert combines product data management with media production for well-known brands, so PIM there directly drives how products appear in every channel. I want to bring my PIM pipeline and integration experience to a company where product data is the core of the business. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.

en.subject: Application: Consultant PIM/DAM
en.hook: PIM projects succeed when product data flows cleanly from the source system into every sales channel. That is precisely what I delivered at Rockwell Automation: I designed, built and optimized PIM data pipelines that keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels – backed by more than five years on SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: Data modeling
